name: Noki Katsumi
source:
She helps out at the convenience store her father runs. She has a cheerful personality and prides herself on her energetic greetings.

She holds a black belt in karate and specializes in roundhouse kicks. She doesn't quite like her tomboyish personality.

[from [url=https://winters.world.coocan.jp/newpage153.html]official site[/url]]
